# Taimoor Khan

> Full-stack product engineer and Flutter developer / Django developer building SaaS platforms, mobile apps, and BLE/IoT hardware integrations (ESP32, STM32) for startups and businesses. 5+ years of experience shipping production systems end-to-end, based in Islamabad, Pakistan, working remotely worldwide.

Taimoor Khan is a full-stack product engineer specializing in Flutter mobile development, Django/DRF backends, BLE/IoT hardware integration, AI/LLM systems, and multi-tenant SaaS platforms. Available for hire on a freelance/contract basis for startups and businesses needing an MVP built, a mobile app shipped, or a legacy backend modernized.

## Services

- **MVP Development** — production-ready MVPs for startups, not prototypes. Next.js/Django/Flutter/PostgreSQL/Firebase.
- **SaaS Development** — multi-tenant architecture, Stripe billing, admin & customer dashboards, RBAC.
- **Mobile App Development** — cross-platform Flutter apps (iOS + Android), offline-first, push notifications, BLE/hardware integrations.
- **AI Systems** — LLM integrations (OpenAI, LangChain), RAG pipelines, intent detection, cost-optimized inference.
- **Automation Workflows** — background task processing (Celery/Redis), tool/API integrations, scheduled and event-driven jobs.
- **Dashboards & Analytics** — real-time charts, KPIs, exports, role-based access.

## Case studies

- [DeenRoot](https://www.taikha.dev/case-studies/deenroot): Free, ad-free Qur'an platform (114 surahs, 6,236 ayahs, 263 translations in 86 languages) with a scripture-integrity guarantee enforced at the Postgres layer, a RAG-grounded AI assistant, and a Redis-locked/circuit-breaker-guarded sync engine with a hard 2-second hydration ceiling. Built solo — Django/DRF + Next.js. Live at deenroot.com.
- [Student Portal System](https://www.taikha.dev/case-studies/student-portal): Multi-role school management SaaS (Flutter/Django/Firebase) — 2,000+ active students across 3 schools, 80% reduction in manual work via biometric attendance and automated reporting.
- [Karwan-e-Falah](https://www.taikha.dev/case-studies/karwan-e-falah): Charitable medical inventory and real-time prescription dispatch system (Django/Channels/Celery) — 5,000+ SKU catalog synced in under 100ms, ~15 hours/week of manual auditing removed.
- [BLE IoT Support App](https://www.taikha.dev/case-studies/ble-iot): Flutter app for BLE device authentication and control with ESP32 firmware — 15+ device variants, 99% pairing success, sub-200ms auth.
- [CRM & Inventory System](https://www.taikha.dev/case-studies/crm-inventory): Unified CRM + inventory + sales reporting platform (Flutter/Django) — 5,000+ SKUs, 500+ tracked sales cycles, ~70% faster reporting.
- [Django Enterprise Legacy Upgrade](https://www.taikha.dev/case-studies/django-upgrade): Zero-downtime migration of an enterprise app from Django 2.x to 5.x — 100% of flagged security risk resolved, +35% query performance.
